title: Scheduled batch job failed
symptoms: CronJob nightly-report failed with exit code 1. Job did not complete within its deadline. Expected output file missing in the morning.
root_cause: Bad input data, a dependency down during the run, or the job hit its timeout.
impact: Reports or exports are missing or late.
fix_steps: Read the job's logs for the failing step.
Fix the input or dependency and re-run the job manually.
prevention: Make jobs idempotent with retries and alert on missed runs.
